title: Cache, sessions, config, env, Octane basics

preview.what: Cache, sessions, config, env, and Octane basics in Laravel specifically.
preview.picture: A sticky note on the fridge (cache) vs the recipe book (database). Sessions are the coat-check ticket. Octane keeps the kitchen open between customers instead of relighting the stove.
preview.why: Config caching mistakes in production are a classic screen story.
preview.bn: Fridge-এর sticky note (cache) বনাম রান্নার বই (DB); session = কোট রাখার টোকেন; Octane চুলা জ্বালিয়ে রাখে।
